messages:
claire: Quick kickoff  two-week tutorial sprint: week1=starter tutorial + refapp, week2=deep-dive tutorial + metrics post. Need owners for post copy, bench narrative, two short webinars (30m each), and inbound routing. Suggestions?
ben: I can own week1 post + social. Aim 120	60 words, 3 callouts (local quickstart, reproducible bench, contrib guide). Propose hero metric focused on p95 reduction with caching.
omar: Ill run benches. Plan compact set: 1) cache hit vs miss (p50/p95), 2) batching cost delta (cost per 1k tokens), 3) tiny quant perf check. Ill produce % deltas + a 3-row summary only.
tia: Ill set up webinars: Tue 30m (intro + hands-on) and Thu 30m (bench walkthrough + Qs). I can host both. Need owners for slides and live chat mods.
design-bot: Uploaded two hero card drafts: /assets/tutorial-sprint-card-a.png and -b.png. Need final hero lines by Mon 10:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Demo clusters provisioned: sprint-week1 (3xA10G) and sprint-week2 (3xA10G). URLs: https://demo.redwood.ai/sprint/wk1 and /wk2. Read-only tokens issued. Expire 72h after each launch.
claire: For messaging A/B test: run two short subject lines and two hero taglines. We'll A/B on 30% of send for 12h then send winner. Ben, can you draft variants?
ben: Variants: S1="Ship a private refapp in 30m (tutorial)" S2="Hands-on: deploy & benchmark a refapp in 30m". Hero A="Predictable tail latency with caching" Hero B="Lower cost, predictable latency".
omar: Will include bench snippet for post (<=4 lines):
```
# cache vs no-cache
wrk -t2 -c100 -d20s --latency https://demo.redwood.ai/sprint/wk1/generate
# quant quick check
python bench/quick_quant.py --model sprint_refapp_v1 --seq 256
```
tia: Webinar pages need form: name, email, org, role, use-case (prod/dev/research), "want-hands-on" checkbox, utm_source=community. Tag leads with SFDC MKG-SPRINT-2026 and lead tag "tutorial-sprint". High intent = attended + demo_click -> route to AE queue E. Low intent -> 10-day nurture.
claire: Also add an experiment: include a short benchmark blurb in the post vs a separate 'bench report' link to see which drives more clicks to repo. We'll track demo-click rate and repo-click rate.
ben: I'll PR week1 post + two subject lines + hero variants by Mon EOD. Can someone grab design signoff? @design-bot
design-bot: Noted. Requested review from @design. Uploaded comment thread.
omar: Ill run final bench Tue night and push CSV + 3-row summary into shared folder. Will confirm hero metric numbers by Wed morning.
tia: Need chat moderators for both webinars. Volunteers? Ben, can you moderate week1?
ben: Yep happy to moderate week1.
claire: Owners: ben=week1 post+social+moderator, omar=bench+metrics, tia=webinars+pages, design-bot=cards, deploy-bot=infra. Check-in Mon 10:00 PT. Any blockers?
omar: No blockers. Will avoid long-running workloads on demo clusters.
ben: No blockers. PR incoming.
tia: Ill create webinar pages and set reg deadlines.
claire: Thanks team :rocket: Keep copy concise and focus on reproducibility and dev experience.
